fusions.name: Snapped Shut
fusions.desc: Clamps onto an enemy at or below 30% health for 20 damage, consuming every affliction you have on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Thrashes violently, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and throwing them back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Wait
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
